forecast_candidates.rationale: Unratified candidate only: direct ETH/BTC closes remained above 0.0300 for 168 sampled hours, and the available sequence windows show positive ETH/BTC returns. A 0.5% move threshold is a bounded research target, not a canonical forecast; persistence alone does not establish broader altcoin rotation.

hypotheses: Legacy pullback hypothesis LKO-PULLBACK-001: partial match only. Short-horizon BTC/ETH weakness and negative BTC aggressive quote flow are present, but breadth and ETH/BTC do not show consistent deterioration; several relevant changes are unavailable or not directly comparable.

Legacy pullback hypothesis LKO-PULLBACK-002: cannot evaluate as a whole. Funding is modestly positive and ETH/BTC persistence is constructive, while the required comparable price-advance and leverage sequence is not established.

Legacy rotation hypothesis LKO-ROTATION-001: partial match. ETH/BTC persistence and positive relative returns support one component, but BTC dominance is available only as a settled daily value, deployment confirmation is not established, and breadth evidence is mixed and proxy-only.

Legacy transmission hypothesis LKO-TRANSMISSION-001: partial match. BTC resilience and ETH/BTC improvement coexist with conflicting breadth readings; evidence does not establish durable ecosystem transmission.

Current evidence does not establish distribution or exit-risk conditions. It also cannot rule out either premature interpretation of late-cycle deterioration while upside persists or delayed recognition if weakness later becomes broad and persistent.

The material evidence is mixed rather than phase-defining. ETH/BTC persistence and positive 72-hour-window returns are constructive, but recent BTC and ETH weakness, negative BTC aggressive quote flow, and conflicting breadth observations limit confidence. The picture is more consistent with an unresolved pause than confirmed re-acceleration or late-cycle deterioration. The 1-hour sequence is unavailable under the existing anchor tolerance, and the forensics observation falls after the stated cutoff. The Action Compass protection-calibration report has no eligible matured rows, so it supplies no calibrated exit or warning evidence.
uncertainties: Breadth readings come from different observation times and point-in-time memberships; their disagreement cannot be resolved from the supplied data.
The 12h, 24h, and 72h API windows have actual spans of 9, 21, and 69 hours, respectively; they are not full nominal windows.
The latest BTC-dominance observation is for 2026-10-04 UTC, rather than a same-time intraday reading.
Stablecoin supply is available only as supply-liquidity context; deployment confirmation is explicitly not established.
Action Compass exit calibration has zero eligible prospective typed rows and cannot support conclusions about exits, re-entry, or warning thresholds.
